ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels against 25% low-intensity black pixels; high contrast interface at the peduncle and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on both lateral lobes; a central dark vertical column bisects the fluke; dark pigmentation concentrated along the trailing margins and in a localized cluster at the inner lower-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp interior pixel-angle; depth is approximately 1/5th of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged peaks along the entire trailing edge; right distal tip exhibits extreme fragmentation/serration; left trailing edge shows more rounded undulating peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep originating from the median notch and curving upward towards the lateral terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Fine, dark-pixel nodes and mottling detected across the lower third of the right lobe; dark pigmentation clusters near the notch area of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel dark linear rake marks visible on the mid-section of the left lobe, oriented vertically across the white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of vertical rake marks on the left lobe; significant tissue loss/ragged fragmentation at the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'feathered' appearance of the right lobe's distal edge due to deep serration patterns.
